mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.title, d.original_filename, d.mime_type, d.status, d.file_size_bytes, d.created_at, dt.auto_tagged, dt.confidence FROM document_tags dt JOIN documents d ON d.id = dt.document_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE dt.tag_id = #{tagId,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM document_tags WHERE document_id = #{documentId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND tag_id = #{tagId,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_tags (id, document_id, tag_id, tagged_by, auto_tagged, confidence, created_at) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{documentId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tagId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{taggedBy,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{autoTagged}, #{confidence}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_tags WHERE document_id = #{documentId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND tag_id = #{tagId,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.update: UPDATE document_tags SET tag_id = #{targetTagId,jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE tag_id = #{sourceTagId,jdbcType=OTHER}
